candidate.title: Work
candidate.problemStatement: People responsible for one real outcome must still reconstruct its state and safe next action across Initiatives, Assignments, WorkRefs, Portfolio observations, workspaces, and Project Cuts even though Kungfu now implements and catalogs Work Control vocabulary.
candidate.scope: Successor cut for a provisional higher-layer or perspective-bound Work candidate under current implementation pressure; independent identity, cross-domain transfer, product qualification, numbering, and universal necessity are not claimed.

observationPerspective.bearer: human and agent participants implementing Initiative, Assignment, WorkRef, Portfolio, review, continuation, and Project Cut settlement
observationPerspective.proximity: inside Work Control identity, authority, lifecycle, query, federation, and settlement behavior
consequences: bears routing, stale observation, hidden authority, premature completion, and continuation defects

genesis.observation: Kungfu now implements Work Control and exposes an experimental Work entry in its derived Primitive Catalog, but the user-level coordinated whole can still be either an independent object, a derived view, Profile vocabulary, Initiative semantics, or no new Primitive.
genesis.candidateObject: Work may be a perspective-bound coordinated action whole whose identity or view preserves component authority, immutable cuts, typed relations, proof state, degradation, and current action frontier across independently owned workspaces.
genesis.claimBoundary: This successor records implementation pressure without changing the provisional decision or deciding between independent entity, derived view, Initiative or Portfolio semantics, product-profile vocabulary, and no new Primitive.

transformedPerspective.bearer: a person or agent responsible for one real outcome that spans independently owned workspaces
transformedPerspective.proximity: inside progress, pending judgment, degradation, settlement, and continuation consequences but outside repository topology
consequences: bears fragmented progress, missed judgment, unsafe continuation, and false completion

genesis.transformation: The observer moved from the implemented component ontology to the participant who must understand and continue the coordinated whole without treating product vocabulary as qualification.
genesis.newlyVisibleNeed: The participant needs one inspectable action whole or reproducible view while exact Initiative, Assignment, WorkRef, Portfolio, workspace, and Project Cut authorities remain independently visible.
genesis.methodNotes: Implementation narrows some evidence gaps but strengthens the derived-view and Profile-vocabulary alternatives as much as the independent-Primitive hypothesis.

contactSides: independently authoritative Work Control objects, workspace observations, and settlement cuts
the participant responsible for understanding and continuing one real outcome
boundaryPressure.implicitHandling: The whole is reconstructed from Initiative grouping, Assignment relations, WorkRefs, Portfolio rows, repository context, Project Cuts, and human or agent summaries.

pressureChanges.description: One outcome can span several workspaces, Assignments, agents, reviews, and settlements.
Portfolio observations remain authority-distinct and may be stale, degraded, partial, or unavailable.
Premature completion or hidden missing evidence changes what may safely continue.

observedFailures: Stage-ready or source completion may be mistaken for independently accepted and settled completion.
Presentation grouping may be mistaken for replica equivalence or shared authority.
A user may still traverse component topology to reconstruct blocking judgment and next action.
A product-level Work label may hide whether the semantics are entity, view, Initiative, or Portfolio.
boundaryPressure.mediationClaim: A perspective-bound Work identity or view may preserve one coherent action whole and frontier without centralizing component authority.
boundaryPressure.internalObjectAlternative: Initiative plus typed Assignment relations, exact WorkRefs, Portfolio, and ordinary cut-bound queries may provide equivalent semantics.

pressure: Work Control now provides concrete component identities and a read-only federated Portfolio.
The Primitive Catalog declares Work experimental rather than admitted or shipped.
Authority-distinct observations and Project Cut settlement must remain independently visible.
Existing Initiative semantics remain the strongest accepted KFD alternative.
grounding.evidenceBoundary: This successor adds public Work Control and derived-catalog evidence at one exact Kungfu commit. It does not convert the product's Work vocabulary into KFD qualification, prove independent identity, measure deletion cost, complete a fixed-root fuse test, demonstrate cross-domain transfer, or supply independent review.
knownGaps: No completed fixed-root comparison between independent Work, derived view, Initiative, Portfolio, and no-new-Primitive outcomes
No measured reconstruction cost for a consequence-bearing user journey
No independent Work lifecycle witness outside the founding product
No retained decision showing that Work changes coordination or settlement while all component roots remain fixed

alternatives.name: Independent Work Primitive
alternatives.reason: A stable identity may be needed when membership, frontier, or settlement scope changes while component roots remain fixed.

alternatives.name: Perspective-bound derived Work view
alternatives.reason: Work may be a reproducible query over WorkRefs, observer, relation policy, component cuts, and availability without a new semantic writer.

alternatives.name: Initiative plus typed Assignment relations
alternatives.reason: KFD already accepts Initiative as a continuing coordinated software-work context.

alternatives.name: Portfolio or product-profile vocabulary
alternatives.reason: Kungfu may need a useful Work presentation without establishing a portable Primitive.

alternatives.name: No new Primitive
alternatives.reason: Existing objects and ordinary queries may preserve every consequential decision at lower ontology cost.

contractModel.identity: Unresolved between stable Work identity and a root WorkRef plus observer, relation policy, and component cuts.
contractModel.boundary: One perspective-bound coordinated whole and current frontier across independently authoritative components.
contractModel.authority: May declare membership or view policy only; may not rewrite Initiative, Assignment, WorkRef, Portfolio observation, Episode, review, Decision, Admission, Project Cut, or workspace facts.
contractModel.lifecycle: Proposed, observed, active, blocked, degraded, under review, continued, settled, or superseded with component state preserved independently.

minimumClosure.notes: Work Control closes a product Profile, but portable minimum fields and independent object necessity remain unproved.

deletion.notes: Implementation creates a runnable experiment; decision change and reconstruction cost have not yet been measured under fixed component roots.

fuse.notes: Initiative, derived-view, Portfolio, Profile-vocabulary, and no-new-Primitive alternatives remain live.

falsifiers: Initiative plus typed Assignment relations and an ordinary query preserves every Work decision at lower cost.
Portfolio provides the same participant value without stable Work identity or new authority.
Changing Work membership or view policy never changes coordination or settlement while component roots remain fixed.
Independent adopters do not reproduce the reconstruction burden.
The Work catalog entry remains only product vocabulary and supplies no retained qualification evidence.

dogfood.notes: A current founding-product implementation and experimental catalog entry exist; comparative KFD-5 dogfood, negative outcomes, and independent review are still absent.

decision.reason: Current Work Control and Primitive Catalog evidence make the pressure operational rather than purely analytic, but they do not decide whether Work is an independent Primitive, derived view, Initiative or Portfolio semantics, product vocabulary, or no new Primitive.
residualRisks: Product vocabulary may be mistaken for KFD qualification.
Independent Work may duplicate Initiative or centralize autonomous fact worlds.
A derived view may hide observer policy, staleness, or unavailable components.
One founding implementation may overfit the candidate boundary.
Presentation grouping may be mistaken for shared authority or completion.
